subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Now they saw it was only one part of the story.”?
options: The lunch bell returned the next day, but a few students started wearing watches.
The broken lights were fixed before lunch, but the teacher decided to use less screen time in future classes.
The next week, they started a campaign at school: "Use less first.
Reading became less lonely when students could leave thoughts for the next reader.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Now they saw it was only one part of the story. The next week, they started a campaign at school: 'Use less first.」，答案為「The next week, they started a campaign at school: 'Use less first.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The next week, they started a campaign at school: 'Use less first.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
